description:
Bring gf2's stored records to canonical writer form so whole-repository `jit validate` passes there under the current binary. This repository owns the verified procedure; the rewrite itself runs in gf2 with its owner's approval.

## Background

Record-fidelity validation rejects gf2's records written by older writers: event lines with an earlier key order, issue timestamps spelled `+00:00`, and one empty gate-run directory. Events are merged with `merge=union`, so rewriting the log on main while unmerged branches append to it can duplicate events unless each branch is canonicalized before it merges.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test on a clone with a real unmerged gf2 branch shows what merging produces after the rewrite, and the outcome is reported.
- [hard] REQ-02: One per-branch script applies the gate-key rename and record canonicalization, covers gate-run records, and a second run changes nothing.
- [hard] REQ-03: Whole-repository `jit validate` passes on gf2 main under the installed binary.

## Notes

The rewrite and removal of the empty gate-run directory need approval from gf2's owner. No product repair path is added: records from older writers are repaired per repository.
title: Repair gf2's stored records to canonical writer form
